name: @suhail-akhtar/aico
description: AI Coder — multi-provider coding assistant CLI (Claude Code compatible). Supports OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Z.AI (GLM), Ollama.
author: Suhail Akhtar

scripts.test: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --clean --target node18 && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('src/skills/builtin','dist-test/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node test-harness.mjs && node scripts/title-sanitizer-probe.mjs && npm run test:miniapps
scripts.bench: npm run build && npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --clean --target node18 && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('src/skills/builtin','dist-test/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node bench.mjs
scripts.test:live: npm run build && npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --clean --target node18 && node live-test.mjs
scripts.test:web: npm run build:web && npx tsup src/server/index.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test/server --target node18 --clean && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('src/skills/builtin','dist-test/server/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node web-live-test.mjs
scripts.test:web:unit: npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/reduce.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/reduce.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/grouping.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/grouping.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/session-memory.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/session-memory.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/settings-schema.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/settings-schema.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/panel-memory.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/panel-memory.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/todos.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/todos.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/plans.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/plans.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/checks.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/checks.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/turn-state.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/turn-state.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/agents.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/agents.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild shared/ui/tool-result.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/tool-result.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild shared/ui/widget-specs.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/widget-specs.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/widget-fixes.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/widget-fixes.mjs --log-level=error && npm --prefix web exec -- esbuild web/src/message-versions.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist-test/message-versions.mjs --log-level=error && node web/test-reduce.mjs && node web/test-ui.mjs
scripts.test:diagrams: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node18 && npx esbuild shared/widgets/diagram-types.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/diagram-types.mjs --log-level=error && node scripts/diagram-matrix.mjs
scripts.test:miniapps: npx tsup src/miniapps/server.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test/miniapps --target node22 --silent && node scripts/miniapp-probe.mjs
scripts.test:supervision: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node22 --silent && node scripts/supervision-live.mjs
scripts.test:nextapp: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node22 --silent && node scripts/nextapp-probe.mjs
scripts.test:nextbuild: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node22 --silent && node scripts/nextapp-build-live.mjs
scripts.test:watchers: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node22 --silent && node scripts/watcher-live.mjs
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build && npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node22 --silent && node scripts/mcp-server-live.mjs && node scripts/mcp-client-live.mjs
scripts.test:mcp:model: npm run build && node scripts/mcp-submit-live.mjs && node scripts/mcp-permission-live.mjs
scripts.test:cron: npx tsup src/test-exports.ts --format esm --outDir dist-test --target node22 --silent && node scripts/cron-live.mjs
scripts.test:vscode: npm --prefix vscode-extension run package && node scripts/vscode-panel-live.mjs
scripts.build:vscode: cd vscode-extension && npm install && npx tsc -p ./ && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.test:panel: npm run build && npx esbuild scripts/panel-tunnel-entry/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/panel-tunnel.mjs --target=node22 --platform=neutral --log-level=warning && node scripts/panel-tunnel-live.mjs
